text:
Xbox announces Xbox Labs, a new initiative to trial emerging ideas and "new technology"

Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has announced the creation of Xbox Labs, a new team within the organisation to "turn emerging ideas into things our players and developers can experience." The unit is a "a small group of game makers, engineers and scientists," drawn from within the business, charged with rapid development, iteration and testing of tools, products and features that will be judged by the reaction of end users. "We'll build in the open, learn from what people do, and measure success by whether more people are playing and creating," said Sharma in the blog post.

"Years of building, pitching and raising for games made the same failure painful to watch" – Why GameDataCore wants to find out how players feel

If you can't understand something, you can't fix it. That's the motivation behind a new platform that aims to cut through the noise of Steam reviews and find out what players really feel about a game, what the developers need to address, and even what game they should think about making next.

Epic Games delays Disney game and tells developers to go "AI first"

Epic Games has delayed its upcoming Disney collaboration - a shooter featuring characters from the Marvel and Star Wars franchises - and told developers to move to an "AI first" production model.
